title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
```

```{r}
#| message: false

mallards <- read_csv("data/mallards.csv")

mallards |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(duck_id, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  summarize(
    min_lat = min(lat),
    max_lat = max(lat),
    min_long = min(long),
    max_long = max(long)
  )
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false

mallards <- read_csv("data/mallards.csv") |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = ymd_hms(timestamp),
    month = month(timestamp, label = TRUE),
    month_num = month(timestamp),
    year = year(timestamp),
    season = case_when(
      month_num %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring",
      month_num %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
      month_num %in% 9:11 ~ "Autumn",
      month_num %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter"
    ),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter"))
  )

write_rds(mallards, "data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
countries <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

mallards_roi <- mallards |>
  filter(between(lat, 47, 55), between(long, 8, 25))

ggplot(countries) +
  geom_sf(fill = "grey95", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(
    data = mallards_roi,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, color = duck_id),
    size = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(8, 25), ylim = c(47, 55), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard GPS Fixes Across Central and Eastern Europe",
    subtitle = "52 tracked mallards colored by individual bird (47–55°N, 8–25°E)",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    caption = "Source: Movebank (Anas platyrhynchos)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
